name: Wind Rose
description: Where the wind comes from and how hard: sixteen spokes of stacked speed bands on frequency rings, with a vane that swings to the prevailing direction.

props.name: data
props.description: One entry per direction: a compass point such as "NW" or a bearing in degrees, and the share of time in each speed band, in percent.

props.name: bands
props.description: Speed band labels from light air to strong wind, e.g. "0–4". Each band is a shade from pale to deep water blue.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit of the speed bands, for the legend and tooltip.

props.name: colors
props.description: Replaces the band colours, lightest band first.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes frequencies. Defaults to one decimal and a percent sign.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The rose fills the smaller of width and height.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the speed band legend under the rose.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the rose shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline. Defaults to the prevailing direction.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the headline. Defaults to how often the prevailing wind blows.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the legend under the rose.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note, action and every other prop of a div.
